messages.content: I want to fix the failing tests in the payment module.
Sure, let me run the test suite first.
test_run: 3 failed, 42 passed -- failures: test_refund_rounding, test_currency_conversion, test_webhook_retry
The test results show that rounding and currency conversion are broken, along with webhook retries.
Only fix the rounding and currency bugs for now. Don't touch the webhook retry logic -- that's owned by another team.
Understood. I will fix the rounding and currency conversion bugs and leave webhook retries untouched.
I'd rather you use the existing Money class than write new rounding logic.
Agreed, I will reuse the Money class instead of writing new rounding logic.
Once fixed, generate a summary of the changes for the PR description.
I will generate a PR summary once the fixes are verified.
